anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature abruptly dropped from 283 °C to 268 then 240 °C after steadily rising
Differential pressure spiked from ~1.9 to 5.7 mbar, then 3.2 mbar
Reflux flow dropped to 0.004 L/h for one sample, and has declined from 0.85 to ~0.6 L/h
System pressure dipped to 396 mbar concurrent with dP spike

args.missing_evidence: Heater power/duty and reboiler level trend, plus whether the PDI702 spike recurs (flooding vs. blockage), and a distillate composition sample
